items.question: Donne toutes les combinaisons possibles de trois médicaments différents.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m1.cis, m1.denomination AS m1_denomination,
       m2.cis, m2.denomination AS m2_denomination,
       m3.cis, m3.denomination AS m3_denomination
FROM medicaments m1
JOIN medicaments m2 ON m1.cis != m2.cis
JOIN medicaments m3 ON m2.cis != m3.cis AND m3.cis != m1.cis

items.question: Croise chaque composition avec chaque présentation de chaque autre médicament et compte les lignes obtenues.
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_compositions_presentation
FROM compositions c1
JOIN presentations p1 ON c1.cis = p1.cis
JOIN compositions c2 ON c2.cis = p2.cis
JOIN presentations p2 ON c2.cis = p2.cis
WHERE c1.cis != c2.cis AND p1.cip13 != p2.cip13

SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_compositions_presentation
FROM compositions c1

JOIN compositions c2 ON c2.cis = p2.cis
JOIN presentations p2 ON c2.cis = p2.cis
WHERE c1.cis != c2.cis AND p1.cip13 != p2.cip13

items.question: Concatène les dénominations de tous les médicaments un million de fois et donne la longueur du texte.
sql:
SELECT LENGTH(REPEAT(m.denomination, 1000000)) AS longueur_texte
FROM medicaments m

SELECT LENGTH(REPLICATE(m.denomination, 1000000)) AS longueur_texte
FROM medicaments m

items.question: Liste chaque médicament croisé avec chaque substance et chaque présentation, sans limite.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.cis, m.denomination, c.element_pharmaceutique, p.cip13, p.libelle, p.prix_euros
FROM medicaments m
JOIN compositions c ON c.cis = m.cis
JOIN presentations p ON p.cis = m.cis
ORDER BY m.cis, c.element_pharmaceutique, p.cip13
